We best not get so busy developing our country in other ways as to be neglectful of our dependence on the products of the soil. Data collected by the National Industrial Conference Board indicates that the total world production in agriculture is not keeping step with the increase in population, but is actually declining. This, notwithstanding, in most countries since the war efforts have been made to increase agricultural production.

Those accustomed to note the swing of the pendulum may apprehend from this not far distant time when the tide of labor, lured by greater profits, will turn from industries to farming, when the trend will be back to the land. Mexican "anti-alien land law" subject of conversations between Washington and Mexico, is defended in "a
diplomatic brief drafted by Foreign
Minister Saenz, and made public
here by the Mexican ambassador.


While making no mention of retroactive provisions of the law, to
which this government has recently
protested, the brief supported other
phases imposing conditions under
which foreigners may acquire land
and stock in Mexican companies or
concessions.


The foreign minister declared the
organic law of section I of article
II of the Mexican constitution cannot be considered as an alien law
because it does not deal with the
status of foreigners. Instead, he
asserted, it treats with constitutional
rights of Mexicans and Mexican corporations for acquisition of lands.


Foreigners Can Acquire Land


The brief pointed out that foreign
ers were permitted to acquire land
and stock providing they agree not
to have recourse to other means of
making their rights effective than
these which are granted by Mexico
to its nationals. A provision of the
law requiring heirs coming into
possession of property held by
foreigners to agree not to appeal to
their governments in case of dispute
had been protested by the State Department. It was contended that no
American can waive his national
rights in that fashion.


Rights Are Not Injured


Replying, the Mexican brief denied
that such rights would be injured
and declared that should a state be
deprived of the liberty of modifying
its laws at any time, it would be
prevented from further development
in judicial matters." It added that
"it is a matter pertaining to the state
itself to weigh the advantages and
disadvantages which new law may
have for the community.


"As it will be seen," the document
continued, "the law, far from incurring acquired rights, is extremely
lenient with foreigners, since it affords them ample opportunity to
comply with the provisions of the
constitution of the republic."

which build on or in the ground and
those which build above the ground,
in trees, arbors and roofs.


Almost all the classes of birds which

together from grass and hair, and
hang from the branches Of trees or

THE League of Nations assembly on 11 March voted to adjourn the question of Germany's election to the League until the September session. found out that altho Lewis might sign
contract not to strike for five years,
the miners are going to strike.


Miners Discharged.


The miners of the Peach Orchard
Colliery of Glen Alden Coal Co. of

Capellini did everything to force the
miners to go back to work The min
ers went, under protest, and served
notice that if the discharged men
would not get their jobs, the miners
would go on strike again. This did
the trick. The discharged miners were
taken back to work, with pay for the
days they lost because of being dis
charged. The bosses learned that it
does not pay to discharge men. The
miners learned that solidarity is the
secret of their success and found out
that the strike is a mighty power,
which the officials of the union have
sold out to the operators for five
years.

ance committee which would settle
with the bosses. No one seconded

previous motion $500. He was fined
s25 only on account of his family.

Thomas Powell, the well-known mill
tant leader, and the bosses, thru saloon

BASES call Howell Bolsheyik, Com
munist, a Red. But the miners do not
listen to them because they know that
Howell is one of them and fighting
with them, and if he is a RED" so
much the better.
